answer.text:
For fiscal year 2024, Citigroup reported (in **millions of dollars**):

| Measure | 2024 |
|---|---:|
| Net interest income | **$54,095 million** |
| Non-interest revenue | **$27,044 million** |
| Revenues net of interest expense | **$81,139 million** |

Calculation: non-interest revenue = total revenues net of interest expense − net interest income = **$81,139 million − $54,095 million = $27,044 million**.

Sources: Citigroup 2024 Form 10-K, accession **0000831001-25-000067**, “Interest Income and Expense,” chunk **107** (net interest income); “Performance by Geographic Area,” chunk **106** (total revenues net of interest expense).
